native_fixture_qualification: positive usage/current-checkpoint pairing before and after the second real manual compaction; usage-free compaction completion
usage_formula: Captured top-level input_tokens + output_tokens; do not add cache_read_tokens again. Terminal-result usage is a distinct representation and is not hook evidence.
capacity_source: Same-session current native store.db ConversationTokenDetails.max_tokens sampled read-only inside each hook collector invocation; never a constant fallback or preCompact substitute.
correlation_method: Controlled sequential session with fixed composer-2.5 selection; receipt checkpoint session matches hook session and used pair. Native checkpoint has no independent captured generation field: correlation uses the native hook generation and current checkpoint observed in that invocation, not an invented checkpoint generation.
receipt_time_semantics: observed_at_unix_ms is temporary research collector receipt/observation time, not AD receipt, provider measurement time or latest checkpoint measurement time. checkpoint_at_receipt.observed_at_unix_ms is the read observation. Production must record its own accepted AD receipt time.
isolation: Fresh HOME/workspace/CURSOR_CONFIG_DIR/CURSOR_DATA_DIR/cache/data, empty GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1. Explicit minimal environment; existing login provider available solely to native runtime via XDG_CONFIG_HOME. No auth files or tokens read/copied/printed and no inherited credential environment passed. PTY bytes drained and discarded. No AD binary executed and no AD store touched.
method_changes: Top-level numeric token allowlist correction follows remote_repeat_probe.py. Repeats a second /summarize after a positive post-compaction ordinary turn, following the b.fzk remote repeat pattern, and read-only checkpoint observation in collector. Uses the successful separated command-text/Enter keypress method.
delivery_integration_handoff: Native interactive callbacks emit usage; the installed ACP path differs. Configure hooks only in launch-owned Cursor configuration. Native child context admission must verify actual registered runtime ancestry/current launch/life/connection/session and must never pass the direct-gateway-parent lifecycle gate by payload claims. Do not relabel fixtures as managed ACP delivery evidence. No flag-based ACP fix was established.
allowlist: Numeric usage/capacity/timestamps, versions/models, session/generation IDs, field names, hashes, process/cleanup/isolation metadata, fixed method and source-code excerpts. No conversation, summary or terminal text, raw databases, encryption metadata or credential contents.
negative_pairing_case: native-mismatch-capture.json preserves real ordinary usage hook sums different from current checkpoint used_tokens. Reject this pair; the cause is not independently proven.
provider_setting_scope: Existing authenticated CLI with composer-2.5 and its unchanged default provider/window settings in the isolated session. Payloads expose no independent provider identifier; no other provider or model configuration is qualified.
event_representation: hooks[] retains allowlisted native payload values and collector metadata. hook is the configured native-event command argument; payload_keys are original payload key names. checkpoint_at_receipt is the read-only collector observation, not a native hook field.
checkpoint_observation_limit: Receipt and read observation are sequential, not an atomic native checkpoint/generation contract. Controlled single-session fixed-model captures establish the observed pairing only.
